draft.title: Access to services and facilities
card: Services and facilities are things a community uses, such as schools, hospitals and shops. Most are found in cities, where many people live close together.
Public transport and internet access are services too. Buses, trains and a good connection help people reach work, school and help. Remote places often have fewer of these as well.
Smaller and remote places have fewer services, because there are fewer people to use them. People there often travel a long way to reach a hospital, a high school or a large shop.
Easy access to services adds to a place's liveability. Long trips, few buses or a weak internet connection can make a place less liveable.
draft.remember: Services gather where many people live, so people far from cities often have fewer of them and travel further.

a.q: What is the main reason a remote town often has fewer services than a city?
opts: Fewer people live there to use the services
The services there are too cheap to run
People in remote places do not need services
Cities have more land for the services
a.why: Services are usually built where many people can use them, so they cluster in cities. Remote places have fewer people, so they have fewer services. People there still need services, which is why they travel.
a.clue: Think about how many people live in each kind of place.

b.q: Mia's family lives on a remote farm in New South Wales. The nearest hospital is a long drive away. How does this most affect how liveable her home is?
opts: Reaching medical help takes longer and is harder
Mia's family has more services close by
Mia's family has no need of medical help
The farm is easier to reach from the city
b.why: A long trip to a hospital makes it harder to get help quickly, which lowers liveability. Having services close by is the opposite of Mia's case. Families in remote places still need medical care.
b.clue: Think about what a long drive means in an emergency.

a.best: Fewer people live there to use the services

b.best: Reaching medical help takes longer and is harder
